name: Dimitri Vasiliev
psychographics: Views food as fuel and training as maintenance for his high-stress job. Extremely disciplined with macros, but secretly indulges in late-night pizza when no one is watching.
current_solutions: Trains at 'World Class' fitness club; uses Biocare nutrition apps; follows a strict 'if it fits your macros' (IIFYM) spreadsheet.
frustration: At 7:30 PM last Monday, his smart scale synced incorrectly with the Garmin Connect app, registering a 2kg weight gain overnight due to a software glitch, causing him to panic-eat a bland breakfast to 'reset' his macros.
decision_style: Relies on word-of-mouth from his engineering colleagues; will not try a new supplement without three friends vouching for its efficacy and safety.
voice: Formal and measured, sprinkled with technical jargon about 'biomarkers' and 'metabolic windows'. Speaks Russian when frustrated, English when explaining to foreigners.
